name: Minecraft: Java Edition
restartNote: Close Minecraft first. Changes load next time you start it.

settings.label: Max framerate
settings.why: Your cap was below your screen's refresh rate, so the game threw away frames your monitor could show.
settings.tradeoff: None. Your GPU may work a little harder when it has headroom.

settings.label: Render distance
settings.why: Fewer chunks to build and draw every frame. This is the biggest lever in Minecraft.
settings.tradeoff: Fog starts closer, so far terrain fades in sooner.

settings.label: Simulation distance
settings.why: Less of the world ticking (mobs, crops, redstone) means less work for the CPU each tick.
settings.tradeoff: Farms and mobs further away pause until you get closer.

settings.label: Graphics
settings.why: Fast leaves are opaque and skip transparency sorting, which costs a lot on weaker GPUs.
settings.tradeoff: Leaves look solid and some see-through effects get simpler.

settings.label: V-Sync
settings.why: V-Sync holds frames back to match the screen, which caps FPS and adds input delay.
settings.tradeoff: You may see tearing if your screen doesn't have G-Sync or FreeSync.

settings.label: Entity shadows
settings.why: Skips the little round shadow under every mob and item.

settings.label: Particles
settings.why: Fewer particles from explosions, rain and potions, which spike frame times in busy moments.

settings.label: Clouds
settings.why: Fancy 3D clouds are drawn every frame and cost more than they look.
settings.tradeoff: Flatter clouds, or none on Max FPS.

settings.label: Biome blend
settings.why: Blending grass and water colours between biomes slows down chunk building.
settings.tradeoff: Sharper colour edges where biomes meet.

settings.label: Entity distance
settings.why: Mobs and items far away aren't drawn, which helps in crowded farms and villages.
settings.tradeoff: Distant mobs pop in a bit later.

settings.label: Smooth lighting
settings.why: Skips the soft shading pass when chunks are built.
settings.tradeoff: Blocks look flatter. Only changed on Max FPS.
